providerLicense: CC BY 4.0 for core nflverse-data sources; source-specific exceptions must be tracked separately

rules: Do not join games by bookmaker fixture ID.
Do not join players by display name when gsis_id is available.
Do not silently rewrite historical team abbreviations outside the provider normalization layer.
canonicalIdentity.teamHistoryKey: provider-normalized current-franchise key; raw nflverse game_id remains unchanged
teamRelocationRules: Normalize team history keys inside the nflverse provider layer only.
Use current-franchise continuity for OAK→LV, SD→LAC, STL/LAR→LA and common nflverse aliases.
Do not use display names as join keys.

schedules.role: canonical game identity, kickoff, teams, venue/rest context, outcomes for target construction only
schedules.marketIsolation: schedule betting columns are downstream/evaluation-only and forbidden as model features

play_by_play.role: primary historical source for team efficiency and QB/play-style candidate features

players.role: canonical player identity crosswalk; gsis_id is primary key

weekly_rosters.role: historical team/player membership and roster context

team_stats_weekly.role: box-score cross-check and supplemental team summaries; not a replacement for PBP efficiency features

depth_charts.role: QB/depth context candidate; schema changed from 2025 onward and must be normalized explicitly

injuries.availability: historical through 2024; nflverse reports the source died after 2024

historicalEvaluationPolicy.developmentSeasons: 2016-2024 are research development candidates for coverage; final training window remains unfrozen until audit review
holdoutRules: Never choose features, hyperparameters, thresholds, or transformations by optimizing 2025 performance.
Do not expose 2025 labels to feature construction for 2025 games.
prospectiveRules: No retraining on 2026 outcomes during the initial validation window.

pregameLeakagePolicy.primaryRule: A game feature row may use only information that existed before that game.
pregameLeakagePolicy.teamHistoryRule: For same-season team performance features, use only rows from weeks strictly less than the target game week.
pregameLeakagePolicy.priorSeasonRule: Prior-season summaries may be carried into Week 1 and early season only as explicit priors.
normalizedArtifactIsolation: game_identity.csv contains only identity and pregame-stable context.
game_targets.csv contains outcomes separately and is never admitted into features.
schedule market columns are not copied into normalized model artifacts.
pregame feature rows are built from prior weeks only; 2015 is warmup history for 2016.

nonGoals: No sportsbook price as a predictive input.
No NFL OddsPapi requests in Phase 1.

snapshotPolicy.purpose: Acquire a recent-era reproducible research snapshot and measure coverage before freezing the training window.
snapshotPolicy.rawStorage: content-addressed SHA256 blob store plus immutable snapshot manifests
snapshotPolicy.normalizedStorage: immutable per-snapshot tables plus CURRENT_PHASE1_SNAPSHOT pointer
snapshotPolicy.dependency: pyarrow 25.0.1 in isolated MODEL Application Support virtualenv
snapshotPolicy.networkPolicy: nflverse/PyPI only for explicit snapshot build; OddsPapi 0
